data.name: Sundown Deadrot
data.detailed_description:
Sundown Deadrot is an intense and immersive shooter with survival elements. A mysterious infection known as the Deadrot has spread across Sundown City and its surrounding areas. Play as one of the few survivors left, trapped amongst Deadrot with almost no hope of survival. Explore a variety of dangerous abandoned settings, each with its own unique questline, mechanics, and challenges.

Play solo or online with upto 2 other survivors.

ESCAPE THE DEADROT

Each map in Sundown Deadrot is a unique setting overrun by Deadrot. You must figure out the path to escape, solving puzzles, collecting key items, and unlocking further areas, all while fending off the Deadrot. This is not an easy game. If you're not careful or if you've been taking it easy and don't have strong enough gear, you'll find yourself swarmed and bitten to death by the Deadrot. The many intricacies of a map will take time to learn, so expect to challenge it several times before beating it. 

SCAVENGE FOR EQUIPMENT

Collect loot strewn across the map to craft and upgrade Guns and Tactical Equipment at Crafting Stations, and Medkits at Healing Stations. Resources are scarce; you must learn to make tough decisions between upgrading a gun or adding a second gun. Perhaps there's a better gun later on, so you might want to save your crafting components...or perhaps not. 

Pick up Fizzy Drinks from now-abandoned Vending Machines to give yourself different buffs. 

Before entering a map, select your Loadout with care and make sure your team has a good mix of offensive and defensive capability.

UNCOVER NEW PATHS

Solve challenging puzzles that will never stay the same twice to unlock new items and escape paths. Hurry or the Deadrot will overpower you before long. Some puzzles are item-based. Some are logic-based. Some are movement-based. All puzzles are fully solo-able, but also fun to do with others.

AND ABOVE ALL...SURVIVE

Good luck.

data.short_description: Intense and immersive survival shooter with crafting, combat, and elaborate escape questlines. Craft guns, solve puzzles, unlock new areas, and escape from the Deadrot solo or with upto 2 other survivors.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
